_about: Email domain typos and their corrections, shared by noise-machine and disco-cater (Kevin, 2026-10-23).

noise-machine: scripts/tests/emailTypoDomains.shared.json. Its TYPO_EMAIL_DOMAINS and the .com-ending part of SOCIAL_DOMAIN_PATTERN (src/lib/dinerType.ts) must equal `exact` and `endings` here; scripts/tests/emailTypoDomains.test.ts fails CI when they differ.
disco-cater: lib/email-typo-domains.json, read by lib/email-typo.ts (the 'Did you mean ...?' hint at checkout and in Order Settings); scripts/tests/email-typo.test.ts runs every vector.
Edit one copy, edit the other in the same change, and check they match: shasum -a 256 on both. Neither CI can see the other repo.

Rules: trim; the domain is everything after the LAST @, lowercased; the local part is kept exactly as typed. An `exact` domain is replaced whole by its correction, or gets NO suggestion when its correction is null (a known typo whose intended domain is ambiguous: hmail.com, aol.co; NM OS still counts it as a typo). Otherwise a last label in `endings` is replaced, but ONLY when the result is in `freeMail` (gmail.con -> gmail.com); never for a company domain (Kevin, 2026-10-23). `freeMail` is NM OS's FREE_EMAIL_DOMAINS and PERSONAL_EMAIL_DOMAINS that end in .com, pinned by NM OS's test. No dot, no @ or no local part: no suggestion.
Warn only: a listed domain can be real, so nothing here may block a checkout or a save.
